nodes.summary: Binds a durable queue to order.created and acks or requeues by handler result.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Pricing CLI: charges a flat 999 cents per unit, ignoring SKU.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Worker: calls the shipping API for each event and updates order status.

nodes.name: requireAuth
nodes.summary: Verifies an HS256 JWT or, when AUTH_DISABLED is set, grants admin to everyone.

nodes.name: requireRole
nodes.summary: Allows the request only when the token role matches.

nodes.name: route POST /orders
nodes.summary: Forwards an authenticated order to orders with customer_id taken from the token.

nodes.name: POST /orders
nodes.summary: Create an order, price it and publish order.created

nodes.name: route GET /orders/:id
nodes.summary: Fetches one order from orders by id; no ownership check and no error handling.

nodes.summary: Admin route that fetches a caller-supplied URL (SSRF sink).

attrs.reason: request input only in the URL path (check downstream handling)

nodes.name: insert_order
nodes.summary: Inserts an order row with a parameterized query.

nodes.name: get_order
nodes.summary: Looks up an order with a string-built SQL query (injection sink).

nodes.name: create_order
nodes.summary: Prices items, inserts the order, publishes order.created, returns pending.

nodes.name: POST /orders
nodes.summary: Create an order, price it and publish order.created

nodes.name: read_order
nodes.summary: Reads one order by id with no authentication.

nodes.name: publish_order_created
nodes.summary: Publishes order.created to the orders topic exchange unless PUBLISH_EVENTS is off.

nodes.name: price_items
nodes.summary: Runs the Go pricing binary over stdin and stdout and returns total cents.

nodes.name: platform
nodes.summary: Three services that talk over HTTP and a queue, plus a shared database and contract. Test data for ckb only. Never install or run it.
